newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sees no post-Deng change in China ties.
newsitem.headline: France sees no post-Deng change in China ties.

text.p: France urged China on Thursday to carry on the work of its late leader Deng Xiaoping by working for a safer and fairer world.

Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, in a message of sympathy to Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen, said he hoped China and France could "seal a partnership for a safer and fairer world" when President Jacques Chirac visited Beijing in May.
"This vision was at the heart of Deng Xiaoping's actions," he said.
Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt said Deng's death on Thursday, aged 92, would not alter French policy towards China.
"There is no immediately perceivable influence in Chinese politics which could lead to changes in French policies towards China," Rummelhardt told a regular ministry news briefing.
